method: Actual game damage and real keyboard/mouse. State/position fixtures isolate individual attacks. Stationary trials and reactive victory keep live AI and original boss HP. Not human balance approval.
checks: Slam: no early damage, animated contact 46, later wave 32; taking the combo never opens the core
Avoided combo opens the core; dash/grace rejection does not count as a landed boss hit
Position outside the strike plus actual Dash through ring earns opening with zero HP lost
Crossing phase HP does not cancel a committed combo
Sweep return, rush, two projectile volleys and ground impacts deal damage and close recovery after connecting
All four classes: stationary held auto attack loses with no boss damage; R restores a living encounter
